name: House — cream plate
one_line: Flat cream plate, matted pop-out in the lower half, graphics in the top zone. The FRAME changes every beat.
use_when: The default. Every short unless Jad names the other style.

ground.white_exception: a captured device is the only reason to use #FFFFFF
ground.media_sits: in the top zone ON the plate — no card, no border, no shadow, no inset

camera.framing: ONE framing for the whole video. Two framings gets the cut rejected.

rotation.rule: a change of CAMERA TREATMENT, not of graphic

captions.note: c-chrome was DELETED 2026-08-20 and is never coming back (BLACKLIST #15)

display_type.note: there is no display type in this style — captions and the CTA pill are the only text

palette.highlighter: --hl-yellow #F7E23C, multiply, ~0.34 opacity / +2 dB — texture, not an event

density_comes_from: layout change + designed scenes + the registry animations
signature_moves: the yellow-highlighter sweep on a real page shot
the old CTA from buzz — logo chip, mono product name, COMMENT/KEYWORD in Instrument Serif italic, ink arrow
